summary: Backend testing completed for me&you iteration 5 - Coin Economy migration. All 35 tests passed. Features tested: wallet packs (4 packs with correct values), wallet balance/transactions, coin-based subscribe/tip/unlock, subscriptions with auto_renew toggle, creator payouts (80% ratio, 500-coin minimum), creator dashboard with coin fields. Stripe checkout for coin packs working. Auto-renewal scheduler logic verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Coin economy correctly implemented: 1 coin = 0.10€, creator gets 80% on all transactions
Pack values correct: starter=50/0/5€, popular=200+20/20€, premium=500+75/50€, vip=1200+250/100€
Wallet debit is atomic (uses find_one_and_update with balance check)
Coin transactions logged with delta (positive for credit, negative for debit) and reason
Payout request correctly calculates EUR: coins * 0.10 * 0.80
Auto-renewal scheduler runs every 15min, renews subs expiring within 1 hour
Insufficient balance returns 402 with {error: 'insufficient_coins', needed, balance}
All endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id from responses
seed_data_creation: Fan seeded with 1000 coins on startup if balance < 100. Creator earned coins from test subscriptions/tips.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coin economy fully tested. All payment flows (subscribe/tip/unlock) now use coins instead of direct Stripe. Stripe only used for buying coin packs via /api/wallet/buy. Creator payout tested with 500-coin minimum. Auto-renewal scheduler logic is in place but runs every 15min so hard to test in real-time - the _run_renewals() function handles renewal/expiration correctly.

auto_renewal_scheduler_notes: The _subscription_renewal_loop() runs every 15 minutes. It calls _run_renewals() which finds subscriptions with auto_renew=true expiring within 1 hour. For each: if sufficient balance → debit wallet, extend 30 days, notify both parties; if insufficient → expire subscription, notify user. Logic verified by code review - hard to test in real-time due to 15min interval.
